overview: This Senate resolution elects Senator Charles E. Grassley of Iowa as President pro tempore of the Senate. The Vice President is officially the Senate's presiding officer, and the President pro tempore presides when the Vice President is absent; by tradition the post goes to the longest-serving senator of the majority party. The President pro tempore is also third in the line of succession to the presidency, after the Vice President and the Speaker of the House. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 3, 2025.
for: Supporters say electing an experienced senator to this post ensures steady leadership of Senate proceedings when the Vice President is not present.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine organizational step that does not change any law or policy.
